messages:
alex (Marketplace PM): Heads-up — the cloud marketplace listing hit a recertification condition from the reviewer. They want: SOC2 cover letter, a pen-test summary + redacted report, updated supplier questionnaire (v2), and SI integration artifacts. ETA from marketplace is ~2 weeks. I created a short checklist: https://internal.docs/rw/mkpl-recert-checklist. Need owners for each item. @maria @sam can you take SOC2 + pen triage? @june can you own SI artifacts?

maria (Partner Security): On it. I'll own the SOC2 cover letter. Where should we upload the doc? Prefer presigned S3 links with 7d expiry.

sam (Compliance Eng): I can take pen-test redaction work. Quick question: do we produce a redacted PDF + a one-page summary or full redacted artifact? Legal needs to sign off on what to redact.

june (Partner Ops): I'll contact SI contacts and map the artifacts we need (cert bundles, signed runbooks, integration diagrams). ETA 4 business days to collect initial batch.

alex (Marketplace PM): Thanks — use evidence bucket: https://s3.console.aws/…/rw-marketplace-evidence. Presign example: 
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://rw-marketplace-evidence/partners/<partner>/SOC2-cover.pdf --expires-in 604800
```
Post the presigned link here once ready. Also add a tiny README with allowed filename patterns.

maria (Partner Security): :thumbsup: Will post presigned link when done. Also we should include a 1-paragraph FAQ for the marketplace reviewer explaining redaction rules and what the summary covers.

evidences-bot: New ticket created: MKPL-4821 - partner evidence ingest. Assignee: maria. Due: 2024-05-05.

sam (Compliance Eng): Legal — cc @henry — can you confirm redaction guidelines? Example items: remove account IDs, secret material, PCI payloads, but keep high-level findings and CVE references.

henry (Legal): Confirmed. Redact keys, active credentials, and exact IPs. We can include scoped findings and an attestation statement from the pen-test vendor. I'll draft the attestation language.

alex (Marketplace PM): Also the questionnaire: marketplace sent v2 (JSON schema). @maria can you coordinate eng-security review, then I'll submit. We need a short note on Private deployment considerations.

maria (Partner Security): Yep. @lina @omar can you review the questionnaire items by EOD Friday? We'll mark any answers needing engineering input.

lina (Eng-Security): I'll take it. Quick flag — marketplace asks whether we support on-prem/HSM-backed keys and quantization/edge hosting. We should make those explicit in the responses.

june (Partner Ops): One more thing — marketing wants to announce the marketplace availability. Hold to avoid premature announcement until recert is cleared. @cam FYI.

cam (Marketing): Noted. We'll prepare announcement copy and a 'what to expect' changelog, but will not publish until you give greenlight.

alex (Marketplace PM): Updated owners: SOC2 cover letter — maria; pen redaction + attestation — sam + henry; SI artifacts — june; questionnaire review — lina/omar; marketing hold — cam. I'll update the checklist and add a small timeline in the ticket. If anyone needs help drafting the FAQ or attestation text ping me.

maria (Partner Security): I'll drop the presigned link and draft FAQ by EOD tomorrow.

sam (Compliance Eng): Will start redaction pass today and sync with henry for attestation wording.

june (Partner Ops): Starting outreach to SI contacts now, will post progress updates in this thread.

alex (Marketplace PM): Thanks team. Small ask — when you post presigned links, include the filename and expected expiry in the message so reviewers can find things quickly. :pray:
